recent.title: LOCAL SYSTEM ENVIRONMENT FOR CLOUD BASED DEVELOPMENT
OPTIMIZING CONTAINER STARTUP PERFORMANCE USING BLOCK LAYER STORAGE

patents.source: USPTO Open Data Portal, granted patents since 2001, applicant phrase "anyscale", 2026-10-03

profile_text.body:
Anyscale is a for-profit startup founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. According to its website, the company is powered by Ray and helps AI builders run data-intensive workloads to build and deploy Foundation Models and AI at scale on any cloud. The site describes orchestration of model training across GPU clusters with elastic scaling, last-mile data preprocessing, and GPU observability, and promotes an upcoming webinar on production-ready distributed inference with Ray Serve.

The site quotes Anastasis Germanidis saying Anyscale enables pushing the boundaries of generative AI by giving the flexibility to scale workloads seamlessly, removing risk around infrastructure and allowing the team to focus on innovation rather than infrastructure bottlenecks. It also quotes an applied AI engineer saying that a model could go from selection to running in production the next day, where before Anyscale that would have taken a week or more.

The company's record shows no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 281.
